title: Add a second wallet
description: Short XRP Mobile tutorial: add another wallet from the home carousel. Create a brand new one or import an existing one, keep balances separate, and switch between them with a swipe. Creating an extra wallet is the one place the app lets you choose between a 12 word recovery phrase and 8 rows of secret numbers.
lede: Keeping your spending money apart from the rest is easier when they are different wallets. XRP Mobile holds as many as you want.

steps.caption: Swipe past your wallet
steps.body: Your wallets live in a carousel on the home screen. Swipe past the last one to reach the add slide.

steps.caption: Create or import
steps.body: You can make a brand new one, or bring in a wallet you already own with its recovery phrase. Balances stay separate and you switch between them with a swipe.

steps.caption: Phrase or secret numbers
steps.body: And here is the part only this screen offers: a new wallet can be protected by a 12 word recovery phrase, or by 8 rows of secret numbers, the format Xaman users already know.
